description: Read one website's stored audit settings: its audit level (quick, surface, full or custom) with the page cap, crawl strategy, rendering and external link checks it sets, the crawl depth, crawl scope and include/exclude patterns, and its recurring-audit schedule. runs_as is how the next audit runs on the organization's plan (a level or page cap the plan does not run is held to the plan there, with a notice) and credits_per_run_max is the most one audit of it can cost. schedule says whether recurring audits are on; pending_first_audit: true means they switch on by themselves after the site's first successful audit, and estimated_cost is the most they spend per run, week and month.

website_id.description: Website id from list_websites, run_audit or add_website.
